$comment: Chunking of one small and one large message, each fragment encrypted on the session from keys.json (fresh copy, nonces start at 0).

source.session: fresh copy of the keys.json transcript; transport nonce starts at 0

small.note: 4096 bytes is below the 48 KiB chunk, so there is no DSBF header: the plaintext is the frame. A 4 KiB message therefore cannot show fragmentation — that is why the 100 KiB case exists.

large.note: 102400 bytes splits into 49152 + 49152 + 4096, three frames, in order. The last one is short.
